limits: Current offline compatibility income and box policy; not original server rates.
Fixed-phase zero-resource-stock arithmetic, not new-account arrival time or a day-by-day campaign simulation.
Other battle and one-time rewards, existing stock, patrol talent and weekly cores shorten the static estimates.
Scripted controller sees live combat objects and makes ten decisions per second; sample wins are not human win-rate measurements.
Individual play may lose or wait for materials. One chapter29 sample lost at the final boss.
Browser captures verify initialization, selection and rendering; complete clear evidence comes from the same production combat kernel.
